fen = Path("game/fen.txt").read_text().splitlines()[-1]

mv = chess.Move.from_uci("f1a6")
assert mv in b.legal_moves
b.push(mv)
with Path("game/moves.txt").open("a") as f:
    f.write(mv.uci() + "\n")
with Path("game/fen.txt").open("a") as f:
    f.write(b.fen() + "\n")
print("now", b.fen(), "turn", "W" if b.turn else "B")
